title: [main] carry out overwrites changed req wksh direct unit cost
summary: Preserve manually entered direct unit costs in requisition worksheets when carrying out to purchase orders instead of replacing them with active purchase prices.
key_points: Manual Direct Unit Cost values are now kept when requisition lines are converted to purchase orders
Root cause was Order Date validation recalculating costs from active price lists
Solution preserves the requisition line's direct unit cost during validation
Added regression test confirming manual overrides survive the carry-out process
Affects multiple localization layers (IT, NA, W1)
quote: Preserve the requisition line's Direct Unit Cost across Order Date validation.
